newsitem.title: USA: Cousins enters office real estate venture.
newsitem.headline: Cousins enters office real estate venture.

text.p: Cousins Properties Inc said on Tuesday that it has entered into a joint venture with Daniel Corp to develop offices and make acquisitions in Birmingham and Nashville, Tenn., and possibly other markets.
As manager of the joint venture, Cousins said it will approve investment opportunities and all major decisions, and provide capital to fund new projects.
Daniel will be responsible for sourcing potential investments and for the development, leasing and management of the venture projects, the company said.
The joint venture is called Cousins/Daniel LLC.

Under the terms of the agreement, Cousins will provide additional capitalization to Daniel by making a loan to Daniel of up to $9.5 million and has an option to acquire certain segments of Daniel's business, Cousins said. The option may be exercised commencing January 1, 1999, the company said.
